name: Longbow Ranger (Elf Ranger 3/Fighter 2)
body:
Ranger
CR 4

XP 1600
Female elf ranger 3/fighter 2
CG Medium humanoid
Init +3 (+5 in forest terrain); Senses low-light vision; Perception +9

DEFENSES

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+4 armor, +3 Dex)
hp 41 (5d10+10)
Fort +7, Ref +6, Will +2; Modifiers +2 vs enchantment; +1 Will vs fear
Immune sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee masterwork short sword +7 (1d6+1/19-20)
Ranged +1 composite longbow +10 (1d8+2/x3) or + 1 composite longbow +8/+8 (1d8+2/x3, Rapid Shot)
Special Attacks favored enemy +2 (Humanoid, goblinoid), Point Blank Shot, Deadly Aim

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 8
Base Atk +5; CMB +6; CMD 19
Feats Dodge, Endurance, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, Weapon Focus (longbow), Deadly Aim
Skills Climb +9, Knowledge (geography) +6, Perception +9, Stealth +9, Survival +9, Swim +7; Modifiers +1 to Survival checks made to follow tracks; +2 racial bonus to Perception checks (inc.); +2 bonus on Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival when in forest terrain
Languages Common, Elven, Giant, Goblinoid
SQ wild empathy +2, favored terrain, bravery
Combat Gear wand of cure light wounds (34 charges); Other Gear +1 studded leather armor, +1 composite longbow (+1 STR) with 20 arrows, masterwork short sword, 125gp
